raw: My first win at the chess club comes to mind. The game lasted nearly an hour, and I finally got checkmate with my last rook. That’s the part I feel proudest of—my last rook, and it was enough. Nearly an hour is a long time to stay with a game. I’m an amateur stargazer, and that makes me think of looking for something in the sky, how one small thing can hold your attention. But yes, that checkmate—that was a proud moment for me.
